title: A taxi fare as a straight line
caption: The expression 3 + 1.8m is a line: £3 at 0 miles and 1.8 more for each mile. At m = 12 it is 3 + 21.6 = £24.60.
alt: A straight-line graph of cost against miles, starting at 3 pounds and rising 1.80 per mile, with the point (12, 24.60) marked.
description: The cost in pounds is 3 + 1.8m, where m is the number of miles.
At 0 miles the fare is £3, the fixed charge.
Each extra mile adds £1.80, so the graph is a straight line of gradient 1.8.
